messages:
devon: hi all, day 1 question: I can see the Templates page in Notion but Duplicate/edit are disabled. where should I grab meeting notes & runbook templates?
priya: welcome! canonical copies live in Company Home > DevEx > Templates Library. we lock the library so only Docs Editors can duplicate or edit templates.
devon: ah ok. how do I get into Docs Editors? I didn't get an onboarding email for Notion perms.
mike: two paths: click Request edit access on the page (creates an Okta ticket) or ping #devex and we'll add you manually. sometimes onboarding bot misses folks.
devon: I clicked Request edit access but nothing arrived. should I post the link here?
priya: post it here and we'll fast-track. also note naming conventions: Team - Short title for most pages; runbooks often start with "RB -". please add Owner, Tags, and Short summary before adding to the Docs Index DB.
devon: posted: https://notion.fake/redwood/templates/aa12. thanks!
devex-bot: devex-bot received request and queued Okta add for devon
mike: added devon to Redwood - Docs Editors via Okta. you should get a Notion email in a minute. after that you can Duplicate the template and move the draft under Company Home > Teams > <Your Team>. then press Add to Docs Index and fill the fields.
devon: got the email and duplicate works :tada: one quick follow-up  when I fork a template, how do we avoid orphaned forks?
priya: if you think the template itself needs an improvement, suggest it in the Templates Feedback thread instead of editing the canonical. if you fork, add a header note "Forked from: Templates Library (date)" and link the template. we also periodically prune stale forks.
devon: great, thanks for the help everyone!
